Re-measured at the merged tip: Minimal hovered row color(srgb .82/.08)=--wash-hover, rail .on =--wash-selected, focused rail-btn inset ring + outline none; Notion the same reads resolve to rgba(55,53,47,.08), rgba(35,131,226,.14), inset rgba(35,131,226,.45).

Pre-change tree, all nine presets fail. In minimal/tokyonight/everforest/gruvbox/dracula the right-click menu, the session list and the terminal pane resolve to ONE value (menu L* == terminal L* == sidebar L*, e.g. minimal 12.7/12.7/12.7): the menu has no fill boundary against the pane it was opened over, only the half-strength --edge hairline at ~1.3:1 and a drop that moves a near-black pixel 1-4 L*. Catppuccin is the same defect 3.4 L* apart. In things/notion the menu is the sidebar's own value; rosepine additionally runs its ladder backwards (sidebar 98.5 ABOVE plane 96.5) because it carries Dawn's elevated 'surface' as chrome.

Same nine presets on the fixed tree, all pass. The ladder climbs one way everywhere: minimal terminal 9.8 / sidebar 12.7 / plane 15.2 / menu 23.1; gruvbox 7.6/12.0/16.1/24.0; everforest 16.6/19.8/24.8/31.7. Dark presets lift the menu 6.9-8.6 L* off the plane and 10.4-12.1 off the sidebar, and 13.3-16.4 off the terminal. Light presets sit the menu at their lightest value and carry the lift with the drop (things/notion 100 on a 100 plane, rosepine 98.5 on 96.5) — the palette has no headroom left, which is the documented split. Every xterm screen paints exactly the value the sheet resolves for --term-bg. Read through the real dashboard against the live backend, on a live session's Terminal tab, with the menu summoned over the sidebar/terminal boundary.
